decisions.reason: As a visibly launched dental-lab product with its own web page in both 2018 and 2019, it fits the firm's core materials portfolio and prior investment makes management likely to continue rather than admit a failed launch.

This thermoforming blank was also given sustained standalone presentation and is closely aligned with the firm's precision manufacturing and laboratory workflow strategy, so escalation of commitment favors retaining it.

Although promoted less prominently, the UV-curing lacquer complements the firm's established dental materials business and disappointing uptake could still be framed as temporary channel or adoption effects, encouraging continued support.

Because the custom earmold line was mentioned at launch but disappeared from the website by 2019, the firm's visible commitment weakened early and there is too little public and strategic stake left to justify further escalation.

Custom hearing protection earmolds match the firm's custom-device capabilities and hearing-care customer base, and continued website presence after launch makes management inclined to persist with the product.
